newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The emerging four-nation South Asian Growth Quadrangle has set its seven-point objectives and principles to govern the economic cooperation among its member states -- Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan.
Chairman of the Local Government Commission, Rahmat Ali MP, on Sunday said the commission would recommend a four-tier local government system to strengthen the democratic institutions in Bangladesh.
Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer arrives in Dhaka on Monday on a three-day official visit to Bangladesh.
Persons accused in the share market scam will not be allowed to travel abroad.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has directed the authorities to take urgent steps to ease the traffic congestion in capital Dhaka.
Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has invited Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to visit Japan.
The central bank states, in its latest report, that invstment in the Bangladesh economy recorded a 17 percent increase in 1995-96 (July-June) from 16.6 percent in the previous year.
Peregrine Investment Holdings, the Hong Investment Bank, has protested to the Bangladesh governemnt over what it described as an unjust and politically inspired action against its staff.
